title: Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning for Segmentation Foundation Models via Visual Grounding (FS-CPL)
mechanism: Learn a continuous concept-prompt embedding from K support image-mask pairs by mask supervision with SAM3 / Medical SAM3 frozen.
evidence: R: up to +0.62 Dice over text prompts on BUSI, HC18, TN3K, CVC-Clinic; backbone-agnostic.
adaptation: One learned prompt per EL class trained on all 478 cells (not K) turns frozen SAM3 into a cheap parametric labeller/second-opinion model for inactive and structural classes; gated weights need the user's OK.
min_experiment: Learned prompts on 478 train cells vs house PF on val54+F51; metrics inactive IoU, splice/gridline IoU, crack relF1@2; kill if below house PF on all and no decorrelated recovery of house misses (>10%).
prior_overlap: none; SAM3 prompt learning not tried.
